tips: Approach steaming shallow pools to refill water before dehydration sets in.
Volcanic ash storms cut visibility—build a basic shelter early.
Stay clear of red meteor impact rings; fresh impacts often leave Primordial Crystals.
Body temperature spikes near lava rivers. Equip a Heat Shield when crossing rifts.
Toxic volcanic gas gathers near active craters—watch your oxygen gauge closely.
Place Fast-Travel Beacons in distant biomes to jump across the 4 km primordial map.

onboarding.slide1Body: No plants, no animals, no other humans exist yet. Only bare basalt plains, steaming shallow oceans, sulfur vents, obsidian fields, meteor showers, and active volcanoes across a 4 km world.
onboarding.slide2Body: Desktop: WASD move, Mouse orbit camera, Space jump, Shift sprint, E interact, I inventory, B build, M map, J journal, F3 debug. Mobile: multi-touch joystick & action buttons in portrait or landscape.
onboarding.slide3Body: Track Health, Stamina, Body Temp, Oxygen, Hydration, Radiation, and Fatigue. Progress through 5 Tech Tiers from stone tools to Archean synthesis and the Seed of Life.
onboarding.slide4Body: PRIMORDIA detected your hardware and selected a balanced graphics preset for smooth 3D playback. Adaptive quality will protect your framerate automatically.

description.title: About PRIMORDIA
description.p1: PRIMORDIA is a browser-based 3D open-world survival game set on primordial Hadean–Archean Earth — before plants, animals, or other humans existed. You explore a 4 km × 4 km world of basalt plains, active volcanoes, lava rivers, sulfur flats, obsidian fields, geyser basins, meteorite impact zones, and shallow steaming oceans.
description.p2: Your goal: survive, build technology from a stone axe to a research lab, then synthesize and plant the first Seed of Life in a hydrothermal spring.
description.p3: Through the Era of Adam & Eve layer, you are an immortal explorer. The sky follows your device clock, the terrain shifts every month, resources regrow every day, and your world keeps running while you are away (up to 24 hours).
description.p4: Play as a guest without an account (offline, saved on your device), or sign in for cloud saves, a leaderboard, friends, messages, and meeting other explorers in the same world.

s1.b: The 4 × 4 km world streams in 64 m chunks with 10 biomes and regional points of interest. The survey map [M] has fog of war, personal waypoints, and Teleport Beacons for fast travel.

s2.b: Watch Health, Stamina, Body Temperature, Oxygen, Hydration, Radiation, Fatigue, and carry Weight. Refill water from warm pools, rest in a Shelter, and manage your temperature near lava.

s3.b: Beware extreme heat near lava rivers, toxic sulfur gas (needs a Gas Filter), red meteor impact circles, and radiation zones. Weather cycles through orange haze, ash storms, acid rain, electrical storms, and meteor showers. Major events: super eruption, toxic gas surge, and orbital meteor storm. A Shelter protects you from almost all of them.

s4.b: Three levels: Explorer (pressure ×0.55), Survivor (×1), Hadean (×1.5). The first ten minutes are a safe period with clean air (except on Hadean). If you fall, your items stay in a Bag where you died (yellow light pillar) and you respawn at a safe spot. Death only adds to a counter; your age is never reset.

s5.b: From the Stone Axe and Water Vessel, to the Workbench and Obsidian Pick, the Smelter Furnace and iron metallurgy, the Archean Research Lab with Meteoric Iron and Energy Cores, up to prebiotic compound synthesis. Recipes unlock based on materials and nearby stations.

s6.b: Press [B]: Floor, Wall, and Roof modules snap to a 3 m grid (R rotates). Available: Shelter, Storage Chest, Condensation Collector, Moss Garden, Auto Drill (works while you are offline), Beacon, and the Terrain Anchor that locks terrain within a 60 m radius. Storms damage buildings without cover, but structures are never destroyed completely.

s7.b: Your age counts from your character's birth date (server for accounts, local for guests). Wisdom Points are earned at ages 7, 30, 100, and 365 days (1/2/3/5 points) for permanent perks in the Pause menu: Lasting Filter, Ash Skin, Ancestral Recipe, Eternal Filter. Four seasons (Dry, Rain, Ash, Cold — 3 months each) affect weather, water, gardens, and temperature. A warning appears before the Great Shift on the 1st of each month.

s8.b: Your expedition score is sent to the leaderboard with server validation (accounts). Finishing all 22 campaign missions triggers the Archean Dawn; continue in Free Survival or start New Game+, which carries over recipes and journal.

s9.b: Online Mode (Pause menu) places players with the same world seed in a room of up to 8; a full room opens the next one. Send quick signals, view the player list, and — when signed in — view profiles, add friends, and message friends. Your inventory and saves are never shared.

s10.b: Choose Male or Female, height, build, skin and hair colors, 7 hairstyles, suit color, and 3 pack models. Your appearance is visible to other players in the same world.

missions.title: Missions & Achievements
missions.intro: The "Seed of Life" campaign has 22 missions across 5 chapters. The active mission shows on the HUD, and a guide arrow helps with early missions.
missions.contract: Repeatable Survey Contract: extract 1 Primordial Crystal or 2 Meteoric Iron and explore 250 m to send telemetry and earn score (Journal [J] → Survey Contracts).
missions.journal: The Journal [J] records 14 field discoveries: biomes, minerals, and natural phenomena unlocked as you explore.
missions.ngplus: New Game+: after finishing the campaign, restart with recipes and journal carried over.

guide.title: How to Play
guide.desktop: Desktop: WASD move · Mouse camera · Space jump · Shift sprint · E action · I bag · B build (R rotate) · M map · J journal · H HUD mode · F3 debug. Keys can be changed in Settings → Controls.
guide.mobile: Mobile: multi-touch joystick to move, drag the screen to look, RUN / BUILD / ACTION / JUMP buttons. Hold a hotbar slot to inspect or drop an item. The eye button cycles HUD mode (Full, Compact, Clean).
guide.st1: Follow the blue pill and guide arrow to the water pool, then press [E] to fill up.
guide.st2: Gather Basalt Rock and Volcanic Mineral, then craft a Stone Axe and Water Vessel.
guide.st3: Place a Basalt Shelter before a storm hits; resting inside restores fatigue.
guide.st4: Head east to the Crystal Crater, then set up a Workbench for Tier 2–3 tools.
guide.st5: Prepare a Gas Filter before entering the Sulfur Flats. A filter is fitted automatically when oxygen drops below 30% (except on Hadean).
guide.st6: Set up a Storage Chest, a Smelter Furnace, and a few building modules as an outpost.
guide.st7: Place Teleport Beacons in distant biomes, and save before exploring far.
guide.st8: Build the Research Lab, then finish the last four missions to plant the Seed of Life.
guide.ti1: Avoid red meteor circles; the debris carries Crystals and Meteoric Iron.
guide.ti2: Temperature spikes near lava — use a Heat Shield or Thermal Cloak.
guide.ti3: When oxygen runs low, follow the green arrow to clean air.
guide.ti4: If you fall, look for the yellow light pillar to recover your Item Bag.
guide.ti5: Build near a Terrain Anchor so your base is not buried by the monthly Great Shift.
guide.ti6: Save to a local slot or the Cloud. On a conflict, choose Keep Local, Keep Cloud, or Keep Both.
guide.ti7: Low FPS? Open Settings → Graphics and lower the preset, view distance, shadows, or particles.
guide.ti8: In online mode, use Signals to communicate, and open the Friends panel to view other players' profiles.

c1.b: By playing PRIMORDIA you agree to these terms. If you disagree, stop using the game. Users under 13 (or the age limit in your region) need a parent or guardian.

c2.b: You may play as a guest without an account. An account (email, magic link, or Google) enables cloud saves, a leaderboard, friends, and messages. Keep your account secure; you are responsible for activity in it.

c3.b: Not allowed: harassing or insulting other players, spam, hate speech, adult or unlawful content, impersonating others, and offensive character names. Also prohibited: cheating, manipulating scores or device time for online advantage, and disrupting the service.

c4.b: Your character name, appearance, and position are visible to other players in the same room. Messages can only be sent between friends. The developer may remove content, limit features, or close accounts that violate these terms.

c5.b: PRIMORDIA is still in development. Features, balance, and the world may change; local progress may be lost if browser data is cleared; online services may stop at any time. Back up important progress to the Cloud.

c6.b: The game, code, and design of PRIMORDIA belong to its developer. Third-party assets are listed on the Credits screen. By using online features, you allow your character name and appearance to be shown to other players in the game.

c7.b: The game is provided "as is" without any warranty, including being uninterrupted or error-free.

c8.b: To the extent permitted by law, the developer is not liable for indirect damages, loss of data or progress, or service interruptions arising from use of this game.

c9.b: These terms may be updated; the latest version applies from the date shown. Continuing to play means accepting the changes. Contact the developer through the project page on GitHub (kalfinstudio-ux/primordia).

c1.b: Settings, language, character appearance, save slots, achievements, and preferences (such as Online Mode and HUD mode) are stored in your browser's local storage. This data is not sent anywhere unless you use cloud features. Delete it via Settings → Account & Data.

c2.b: If you sign in, we store through Supabase: your account email (handled by the authentication service), display name (character name), character birth date, death count, last-seen time, settings, cloud saves, and leaderboard score. Your email and account username are not shown to other players.

c3.b: In Online Mode, only the following is sent to other players in the same room: character name, appearance (including character gender), position, heading, animation, signals, and — when signed in — your account ID so your profile can be opened. Inventory, saves, and other account data are not sent. Rooms are public; turn off Online Mode in the Pause menu anytime.

c4.b: A public profile only shows character name, age, death count, score, and friendship status. Messages are stored on the server and can be read by the sender and recipient. Messages are not end-to-end encrypted, so database administrators can technically access them.

c5.b: Supabase (database, authentication, and realtime), Google (optional for Google sign-in, and Google Fonts for typefaces), and GitHub Pages (hosting) process technical data such as IP addresses under their own policies.

c6.b: This version of the game shows no ads and installs no analytics trackers. The service worker only stores game files on your device so it can be played offline.

c7.b: Connections use HTTPS. Cloud data is protected by per-user access rules (row level security), and writing scores, age, and friendships goes only through validated server functions. No system is completely secure; do not send sensitive information in messages.

c8.b: You can play as a guest, turn off Online Mode, sign out, delete local data, and remove friends. To request deletion of your cloud account data, contact the developer through the project page on GitHub.

c9.b: This game is not intended for children under 13 without a parent or guardian. This policy may be updated; the effective date is shown above. Questions: GitHub kalfinstudio-ux/primordia.
